description.value: café de A is a traditional Hong Kong café in Richmond's Ironwood neighbourhood, serving authentic Cantonese cuisine and Hong Kong-style barbecue meats — including roasted duck, char siu pork, roasted pork belly, and soy sauce chicken — prepared using time-honoured Cantonese methods. The café covers a full day of service from breakfast through dinner and afternoon tea. Both dine-in and takeout options are available, making it a potential meal stop for cyclists riding the Steveston Highway corridor.
